## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, expected result and why this change is needed.
Link the issue or approved scope when applicable.

## Validation

List the exact commands actually run and their results. Distinguish scoped
checks from complete integration evidence. State unverified platforms or cases;
do not substitute an agent's assertion for recorded output.

## Compatibility and trust

Describe any command, state, test-evidence, API or trust-boundary change.
Mention migration and documentation updates. For a docs-only change, say so.

- [ ] Existing attack assertions and clean controls are preserved.
- [ ] No credentials, private project data or unnecessary scratch files are included.
- [ ] Limitations and same-agent review are disclosed where applicable.

Do not publish vulnerability details here; use the private security channel.
